records.rejected_claim: The corrected out quasi-Gini construction is a newly discovered general class of means.
records.required_wording: The corrected construction is a weighted Bajraktarevic mean; its contribution is the correction contrast, proved parameter-transform properties, and use inside the SmartDCA architecture.
records.reason: Prior-theory review identifies the off-diagonal construction exactly within a known family.

records.rejected_claim: An economically distinct causal, fully funded SmartDCA policy universally dominates the same-deposit DCA comparator.
records.required_wording: Universal pathwise dominance forces transaction-level DCA; the guarded policy supplies only a chosen relative-wealth floor.
records.reason: The causal DCA impossibility theorem excludes the stronger claim under the complete comparison model.

records.rejected_claim: The frozen corrected-mean score has confirmed incremental historical value over the neutral guarded selector.
records.required_wording: The registered signal-only comparison had no Holm-significant H2 result and therefore did not confirm incremental signal value; this is not an equivalence result.
records.reason: Seventeen of eighteen signal-only medians were negative, one was positive, and none was significant after the registered correction.

records.rejected_claim: The epsilon-DCA theorem guarantees the same relative-wealth floor after transaction costs, taxes, slippage, interest, dividends outside declared series semantics, or market impact.
records.required_wording: The theorem is frictionless; cost-adjusted outputs are finite empirical robustness calculations outside the current safety theorem.
records.reason: The proof uses the frictionless unit-coverage model and no extension to frictions has been established.

records.rejected_claim: Historical or stochastic outcomes establish causal, expected, or market-wide superiority or inferiority.
records.required_wording: Report realized associations and controlled sensitivities within each declared evidence layer, preserving overlapping-window and small-seed limits.
records.reason: The empirical design does not randomize market regimes, define a population from deterministic catalogs, or support pooling across inferential units.

records.rejected_claim: A lower average acquisition cost by itself establishes superior economic performance under unequal spending paths.
records.required_wording: Average acquisition cost is an accounting quantity; economic comparison uses cash-inclusive terminal wealth under the same deposits and horizon.
records.reason: Different carried-cash and unit paths can reverse the ranking implied by acquisition cost alone.

records.rejected_claim: Epsilon-DCA safety protects contributed principal or imposes a maximum drawdown bound.
records.required_wording: The floor is relative to same-deposit DCA wealth; DCA can itself lose value, and the theorem does not supply capital or drawdown protection.
records.reason: The guarantee bounds terminal wealth relative to DCA under its specified model, not relative to deposits or a past wealth peak.

records.rejected_claim: The frozen coverage grid or favorable finite witnesses identify an optimal parameter or monotone return improvement from more discretion.
records.required_wording: Coverage controls the mandatory floor and funded discretion; realized performance remains path-dependent and no optimal configuration is established.
records.reason: The synthesis retains mixed synthetic signs and descriptive historical sensitivity without a parameter-selection claim.

records.rejected_claim: Deferred parameters, new datasets, selectors, guardrails, or regime analyses are already part of the accepted thesis evidence.
records.required_wording: Treat these as separately specified future work with new evidence identities, appropriate registration, and independent review.
records.reason: Four declared alternate corrected-mean configurations remain unexecuted; outcome access closes the primary selection boundary.
